meta.name: playwright-cli
meta.description: Automate browser interactions, test web pages and work with Playwright tests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页上的点击、填表和检查变成可重复运行的自动化流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常手动重复点网页做验证,想改成脚本一键跑。
copy.tagline_en: Turn clicking, filling and checking web pages into repeatable automated flows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you retest web pages by hand and want a script to run it.

howto.what: Claude 会用命令行浏览器操作网页:打开页面、按快照引用点击和输入、截图或存 PDF、查看控制台与网络请求、保存 Cookie 与本地存储,并生成 Playwright 脚本。
howto.when: 当你需要让浏览器自动操作网页、测试页面、调试网页问题或处理 Playwright 测试时,它会执行对应的 playwright-cli 命令。

say.note: 启动浏览器并保存截图文件

say.text: 看看这个页面控制台报了什么错
say.note: 运行 console 命令返回日志

say.text: 把当前登录状态保存到 auth.json
say.note: 执行 state-save 写入文件

howto.what_en: Claude drives a browser from the command line: opens pages, clicks and types using snapshot refs, takes screenshots or PDFs, reads console and network requests, saves cookies and storage state, and emits reusable Playwright code.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want a browser driven automatically to test pages, debug a web app, or work with Playwright tests.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com and take a screenshot
say_en.note: Starts the browser and saves the image file

say_en.text: Check what errors the console shows on this page
say_en.note: Runs the console command and lists logs

say_en.text: Save the current login state to auth.json
say_en.note: Runs state-save and writes the file
